hooks.description: Turn on the commit gate's git hooks (.githooks) for this clone and all its worktrees

fmt.description: Format and lint-fix with the pinned Biome; pass paths to limit it (default: the project)

gen:main.description: Generate main (method-chaining) entrypoints from mini; pass --check to verify they are current

dv.description: Run the pinned dv release CLI (scripts/dv), e.g. `deno task dv status`

docs:assemble.description: Assemble the docs site's pages from every README and package docs/ folder

docs:dev.description: Serve the docs site locally with live reload
docs:dev.command: deno task docs:assemble && cd scripts/docs-site && deno run --no-prompt -A npm:vitepress@1.6.4 dev

docs:build.description: Build the static docs site into scripts/docs-site/.vitepress/dist
docs:build.command: deno task docs:assemble && cd scripts/docs-site && deno run --no-prompt -A npm:vitepress@1.6.4 build

compat:test.description: Run every package's unit tests on a non-Deno runtime: node, bun, chromium, firefox, webkit or workerd

compat:smoke.description: Install the published packages from JSR on a runtime (node, bun, chromium, firefox, webkit, workerd) and smoke-test every export path

play:notebook.description: Create playground/start.ipynb from the starter notebook (never overwrites)

add.description: Add a workspace to the repository
